entries.title: Nehemiah 6:2
segments:
The plain of Ono; in the tribe of Benjamin. 
 
When the efforts of wicked men to hinder the work of God are disappointed in one way, they are often tempted to try another.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:7
segments: The king; the king of Persia.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:9
segments:
Made us afraid; attempted to make us afraid. 
 
Fear of men is unbecoming in the people of God, and when threatened, they should look up to him for the courage, wisdom, adn strength which they need, go forward in duty, and let nothing hinder them from learning and doing his will, committing themselves and their cause to his wise and gracious disposal.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:11
segments:
Being as I am; having a good conscience, and being engaged in the work of the Lord. 
 
Sometimes, if need be, it is proper in a good cause to endanger one's own life, but it is never proper to do wrong in order to save it; for he who thus saves his life shall lose it, and he who loses his life in doing right shall keep it to life eternal.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:15
segments: Sometimes God so manifestly appears in support of his cause, that even its enemies see his hand, and are convinced that their efforts to stop it will be unavailing.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:16
segments: Was wrought of our God; that he was with the people and blessed them in their work.

entries.title: Nehemiah 6:18
segments: Shechaniah--and--Meshullam; foreigners whose daughters Tobiah and Johanan had married.
